## About
One & Done Handyman is run by Loren. Reviewers describe him as friendly, reliable and quick to figure out what a job actually needs.
One reviewer had other contractors come out and said Loren was the only one who really understood how to repair the items. Another called him "the ultimate problem solver for tasks and issues around my house."
We're based in Walnut Creek and hold a 4.9 rating on Google from 33 reviews.

## Services
- Water damage repair: Repairs to roofs, ceilings, walls and floors after water damage. One reviewer said the finished project looks gorgeous.
- Painting: Painting around the house, including accent walls.
- Gate door, gate lock and fence: One reviewer had Loren sort out a gate door that shifts with the seasons, a second gate lock, and a fence that needed securing and straightening.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of jobs does Loren take on?
A: Tasks and issues around the house, especially the ones you don't have the time or know-how to handle yourself.

Q: When can I reach you?
A: Our Google listing shows us open 24 hours Monday through Saturday. We're closed on Sunday.
